policy: Compact JSON retains complete numeric arrays, commands and identities; selected logs only.
normalization: UTF-8/LF, private paths and pointer-labelled transient addresses normalized; IDs/codes/hashes unchanged; protocols retained verbatim.

limits: Historical image reanalysis requires surviving local final images or a new GPU run; cross-stack byte/timing identity is not promised.
